rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b (2026-10-04): all 29 periods rerun in 7 input configurations (bge and gte-modernbert, DQ5 dedupe, style residualization, shared goal vectors) and three native tests (G51 newcomer clock, G27 block switch, NE43 drive withdrawal) with dated predictions; per-period estimates written. Holdout not run; sub-day clocks remain round-2 work.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (aging) fails in both embedding models and every configuration; #38 is the quench rival; #51 rejects mu = 0.5 aging; style residualization removes even #51's weak late slowing. Natives add no rejuvenation. Scorecard unchanged (A1 B1 C1 D0 E0 F1 G1 H0 I0).
rationale.usefulness: A model-robust settling picture (settle within days, then stationary; newcomers relax on their own clock) and a methods warning that now extends to step tests (fitted stationary nulls are too narrow at ordinary day boundaries). Reassurance, not a lever.
